spec.producer_rule: the def whose body contains the face's study literal; arithmetic class is read from the tokens that def reaches through the module's own call graph (_daily_rets, _month_daily_rets, _tilt3decom_blocks)

class_rules.count: E208: leaf name carries a whole-token count word from ('count', 'counts', 'num', 'n', 'sessions', 'shards', 'files', 'leaves', 'members', 'arms', 'ids', 'rank', 'length', 'names', 'faces', 'pulls', 'trials', 'eligible', 'kept', 'cells', 'behind', 'ahead') -- a quantity of things, so it is retired instead of quoted
class_rules.derived_daily: contains one of ('decomposition', 'arithmetic', 'unanchored') -- E177 reading (a), a sum of daily w*r
class_rules.arithmetic_of_levels: contains one of ('legs_sum',) -- a sum of LEVELS
class_rules.anchored: level-shaped (bp/level in the name) and none of the above
class_rules.not_a_level: contains one of the descriptive tokens ('delta', 'diff', 'sd', 'tolerance', 'share', 'pct', 'deadband', 'sign', 'change', 'heap', 'join', 'months', 'residual', 'count', 'beta', 'r_squared', 'corr', 'stability', 'abs', 'quantum', 'band', 'cutoff', 'yield')

spec.spec_subtree_excluded: cells under /spec/ are declarations, not quotes
spec.units: bp as published by the producing face

answers.reading: 31 faces carry 1967 level cells: anchored=1882, arithmetic_of_levels=5, derived_daily=80, offset=488. 5 face(s) quote a DERIVED (sum of terms) level, 2 from a producer that reaches the daily returns (60 cells) and 3 from a monthly producer (25 cells); 5 of those faces publish an offset beside the sum and 0 do not. 1 field name(s) are published from BOTH arithmetics (decomposition_engine_bp), and on 10 comparable cells the two answers differ by up to 3.63 bp -- the label alone does not identify the object. 488 offset cells are published across the family; where one is the same construct as an E177 column (40 compared) the two disagree by up to 3.58 bp -- an offset is a book-specific number, so 'the compounding gap' as one headline is a category error.

cross_check.note: sum_named_levels groups every derived-class leaf NAME by whether its producer reaches the daily-return helpers. A name published from both sides is a collision: the same label on two different objects. The second list is coverage, not a defect -- those faces were burned by a leg the census source does not declare

honest: E208 changed this table: a leaf whose name carries a whole-token count word (('count', 'counts', 'num', 'n', 'sessions', 'shards', 'files', 'leaves', 'members', 'arms', 'ids', 'rank', 'length', 'names', 'faces', 'pulls', 'trials', 'eligible', 'kept', 'cells', 'behind', 'ahead')) is retired into `count_named_cells` instead of being filed as a level, because E207 showed a count can sit under a gap/level name and be quoted as bp. The retired cells are listed per face, with the class the old table gave them, so the change is auditable rather than a silent drop

the classification is NAME-based, not value-based: a cell is derived because of how its producer builds it, and the name rules encode E177's vocabulary. A cell renamed without re-burning this leg would be misread, which is why every cell is published with its path

derived_arith is per FACE, not per cell: a producer that reaches the daily helpers may still mix both arithmetics inside one face, so a collision on a shared name is evidence that two faces disagree, not that one face is internally inconsistent
offset cells are published by their own faces, so 'publishes an offset' says the number is on the page -- it does not say the offset was subtracted from the quote the reader sees
only offsets in COMPARABLE_OFFSETS are differenced against E177; the rest are inventoried with reason 'not_the_same_construct' (a decomposition of an offset is not the offset)
offsets are BOOK-specific (E177: engine 28.41 / wide -29.33 / ladder -57.74 bp on pre2017), so the wide/ladder rows are compared to their own E177 columns, never to the engine column
cells under /spec/ are excluded: a declared tolerance is not a published quote
the E177 join only covers (arm, era) keys that face publishes; a derived cell without an era is joined to nothing rather than to a guess
